use_case_summary: DevFlux builds an IDE copilot for enterprise dev teams. They need deterministic code completions tied to specific model artifacts so each release can be reproduced and audited. Workloads: short completions (single-line to multi-line snippets), high QPS from editor telemetry, and low-latency streaming for real-time typing experience.
technical_requirements:
- Model/version pinning: pin model checkpoints, tokenizer hashes, and quantization profile per release; store artifact checksums in rollout metadata.
- Rollouts: percent-based canaries (5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%), automatic rollback on eval-gates fail.
- Eval gates: run unit-tests against canonical prompt set (10k snippets), thresholds: top-1 match >= 92% for critical snippets, hallucination rate <1.0%, latency median <30ms.
- Reproducibility: deterministic seeds, KV-cache warming for prefetch, ability to replay request id and produce identical completion for debugging.
- Observability: token-level traces, model-hash in logs, traceable request->model mapping, diff reports between model versions.
- Fallbacks: automatic routing to quantized fallback model if latency SLO breached or tail error rate increases.
- Compliance: must support EU residency for select customers, KMS for key management, SSO/SAML for team auth.
